description.en: Evidence-informed whole-organism exterior reconstruction of Louisella pedunculata, not measured specimen replica. ROM morphology and actual complete USNM57616 plus folded holotypeUSNM57558 consulted. Miskoia preciosa is synonym not separate asset. Nominal30cm body length follows reported maximum, not exact specimen measurement. Circular section, pose, colors and spacing are artistic; possible gill role of papillae not asserted as settled.
